items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: I just felt like Mary Martin felt about videotaping, that it’s going to take away from live performance.

ctx.x: The first recording that I did solo, which was really late in my career, for a long time I didn’t believe in recording because I mean I had opportunities but I just felt like Mary Martin felt about videotaping, that it’s going to take away from live performance. And you know what? I was right. I mean look at, people are staying home and — anyway. But that first recording I did, I did because I was cussing a lot of musicians. Well Jimmy Yancy and Big Maceo and all these wonderful musicians who had not recorded…
thing, four cuts. But anyway so that was the reason I first started recording was I thought maybe somebody might want to hear.
